notes.title: The first days after the release
notes.notes:
Hello all

The first days after the start of the alpha are now over and to our delight the first people have bought the game.
Nonetheless, we know of course, the game still needs a lot of care and especially content.
In the next few days we will release the first update, which will include the following things.

1. a system that makes it easier for us to implement new languages. the first language to be implemented will be german, if you want your language in the game let us know.
2. an improved menu, which will allow custom key bindings, more settings for the graphics and sounds.
3. fixes regarding loading speed and game crashes.
4. fixes regarding sound, collider and animals

I know, this is not so much, but in the following you can read, what you can expect until the beta in december.

-Working Npc's that work for you
-Improvement of the saving system
-Improvement of the map generation
-More items and an improved overlay for crafting
-More huntable animals 
-Improvement of the dynasty system
-Survival features, such as food, drink, and a health bar.

Feel free to submit suggestions and let me know about bugs and issues by creating a ticket on our Discord server or posting in the questions or bug report channel.
Have fun gaming and we will see you around.

notes.title: Age of Dynasty Alpha-Release
notes.notes:
Age of Dynasty is an open-world survival game that spans from the end of the Stone Age to the future. Every playthrough is 
different because of randomly generated worlds and the possibility to play together with your friends.
As a young woman/man you have to fight your way through the last days of the ice age and end the age of hunter-gatherers.
You'll have to build a city and manage its inhabitants to reach new eras and always unlock new buildings and items.
This is the link to the official discord server, where you can get more information and updates in the future.
The Alpha release date is at 9.September.
